subheading: CLASSIFICATION BASED ON CLINICAL COURSE OF P. FALCIPARUM
subheading_corrected: Classification Based on Clinical Course of P. falciparum
text:
Classification based on clinical course of P.falciparum.
- Asymptomatic parasitaemia
- Acute uncomplicated malaria
- Severe malaria
Asymptomatic parasitaemia
- Affects older children and adults living in high malaria endemicity.
- Have acquired natural immunity to clinical disease.
- Have malaria parasites in the peripheral blood but no symptoms.
